title: Almost-Perfect S-Box Permutation Construction
summary: For almost-perfect n-bit S-box permutations, the target maximal differential probability is two to the minus (n minus one), but no construction is known.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved construction problem is to construct, for an $n$-bit S-box, an almost-perfect permutation whose maximal differential probability is $p_{\max}=2^{-(n-1)}$; the supplied source states that such a construction is not known.

scope.domain: Design of almost-perfect permutation S-boxes under differential-probability criteria.
parameters: n: bit width of the S-box
p_max: maximal differential probability, targeted at two to the minus (n minus one)
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct an almost-perfect n-bit S-box permutation attaining the target maximal differential probability.

citations.label: Structural Evaluation of AES and Chosen-Key Distinguisher of 9-Round AES-128

progress.summary: The source presents this as a concrete unresolved construction limitation, stating that the authors do not know how to build an almost-perfect n-bit S-box permutation attaining the target.
citation_labels: Pierre-Alain Fouque et al., Structural Evaluation of AES and Chosen-Key Distinguisher of 9-Round AES-128
